About the Practice

The University of Rochester is a private research university in Rochester, New York, founded in 1850. It is among the nation's top research universities, with a classification of "R1: Doctoral Universities – Very High Research Activity." [8] The university offers a wide range of programs across its seven schools, including Arts & Sciences, Engineering, Music, Medicine & Dentistry, Nursing, Business, and Education. [2, 8] The University of Rochester Medical Center (URMC) is a key part of the university, serving as a major hub for health research, teaching, and patient care in Upstate New York. [14, 11] URMC provides tertiary care and includes specialized centers for areas like trauma, burn care, cancer, epilepsy, psychiatric/behavioral health, and organ transplants. [11] They also have programs focusing on specialty mental health care and are expanding services like orthopaedics and physical performance. [7, 13, 16]
